text: I used to love bark com....but they have oversaturated the leads, too many people want them, even if it's come straight in, within 30 seconds someone has responded, they have also increased the credit values for each lead and increased the prices of having to pay for credits. Greed has unfortunately gotten the better of this company...I have 100 percent 5/5 review rate and am always being asked by customers to contact them but by the time I do they've already spoken to two or three cowboys who offer a fair more inferior service...this will become the downfall of bark.com...as the services will be a far more poorer quality, so people won't bother coming back...I think if you have a 5/5 rating you should be offered the lead before others as to keep the quality of the services set at a premium and therefore getting far more returned customers and referrals...their estimate on responses with credits purchased is a complete lie...I recently spent £126 for 60 leads...spoke to one person out all the leads and won the job worth £115....absolute waste of time....such a shame because it was once a fantastic tool to use..... But greed eventually takes priority with these firms. Shame, they've missed the point of what they were doing when the money started rolling in....and be sure of that, their once great marketing tool will become too frustrating for the tradesman and they will quickly retreat....I can't see them lasting much longer if they don't fix the issues. I won't be sticking around much longer unless drastic changes are made...my company made this business look good, I offered a premium service and was close to purchasing 1200 lead for £1620, that was a close call. They can keep the rest of my credits, I can't see that I'll get any leads from this company again, they should be refunding us, but they won't. Greedy greedy greedy.
